title: JFrog security advisory (AV26-867)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-867 Date: September 1, 2026 As of August 28, 2026, JFrog is affected by a vulnerability in the following product: Artifactory Prior to 7.111.21 Prior to 7.117.28 Prior to 7.125.20 Prior to 7.133.29 Prior to 7.146.38 Prior to 7.161.20 Open-source reporting indicates that CVE-2026-82329 related to JFrog Artifactory is being exploited in the wild. The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Artifactory Self-Managed Releases JFrog Security Advisories Article Link: JFrog security advisory (AV26-867) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
